messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging oncall: elevated 5xx rate observed on streaming gateway (stream.v1). Alert: spike to 12% 5xx, connection resets and chunked-encoding errors. Monitoring: https://perf.redwood/alerts/1764567890 , runbook link: https://confluence.redwood/streaming-troubleshoot
jay (oncall): I’m on it. seeing 502s and ECONNRESET in gateway logs. Any recent deploys?
matt (eng-runtime): deploy-bot shows a config push at ~15:02 UTC that touched keepalive/read_timeout settings on the gateway. Not sure if that correlates.
deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-15T15:02Z by matt pushed: gateway/nginx: tune keepalive and http2 chunked buffer.
amelia (support): Customers reporting truncated streams and rapid reconnect loops. Affected customers: 3 high-volume tenants. They're seeing partial payloads, then client cancels.
jay (oncall): Repro steps? I can try curl to reproduce.
matt (eng-runtime): Repro command we used in staging:
```
curl -v -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \ 
  -d '{"input":"stream test"}' https://stream.redwood/v1/stream/answer
```
Expected continuous chunked frames; in prod we see abrupt CLOSE after ~10-20s. Gateway logs: `upstream read timeout` and `client reset` entries.
leo (ops): Gateway error sample: `2026-03-15T15:12:04Z gateway[proxy-7]: upstream timed out (110: Connection timed out) while reading response header from upstream` followed by `client closed connection` and `chunked encoding failed`.
jay (oncall): Initial triage: looks like upstream (runtime) is responding but gateway is dropping the connection mid-stream. Could be buffer/keepalive mismatch. I'll try toggling keepalive back to previous values on a single node as a live mitigation.
amelia (support): Please update on customer messaging. I’ll draft a short status: "We're investigating streaming disconnects; temporary degradation for some customers; working on mitigation"
matt (eng-runtime): Quick observation: we also deployed a runtime patch that limits per-connection buffer to reduce memory; if runtime flushes chunks differently, gateway's chunked parser may see an unexpected EOF. Rolling back runtime patch on a subset might help.
jay (oncall): Two parallel actions: 1) rollback recent gateway config on one lb (hotfix) 2) scale up runtime pool and route affected routes to older runtime version via canary routing. Which is faster?
matt (eng-runtime): Hotfix gateway config is fastest. I'll coordinate a runtime fallback if gateway hotfix doesn't stabilize.
leo (ops): I'll run a one-node gateway rollback on proxy-7 now, monitoring errors.
--- command run by leo (ops): ---
ssh proxy-7
sudo cp /etc/nginx/conf.d/gateway.conf.backup-20260315 /etc/nginx/conf.d/gateway.conf && sudo systemctl reload nginx
---
jay (oncall): Reload done, monitoring metrics.
(2m) jay (oncall): Error rate dropped from 12% -> 4% on proxy-7 paths. Still elevated on other LBs.
leo (ops): Rolling same change across other gateways with a controlled pace (1/4 at a time).
(8m) matt (eng-runtime): Runtime team standing by to rollback the buffer change if we still see anomalies after gateway rollouts.
amelia (support): Notifying impacted customers with high-level note. ETA for next update in 30 mins.
jay (oncall): Also enabling a temporary route-level fallback: if streaming fails we'll return paged non-streaming responses for affected customers to avoid client disconnect loops. Implemented via route flag: `streaming_fallback: paged` on AB test config.
matt (eng-runtime): Note: paged fallback increases latency and cost but avoids partial stream truncation. Good for short-term mitigation.
leo (ops): Applied routing change for tenants tenant-42 and tenant-88.
(20m) jay (oncall): Aggregate impact: overall 5xx now 1.8% cluster-wide after rollouts and routing fallbacks. Customer-impacting appears limited to the 3 tenants; their traffic is now routed to paged responses; support is contacting them.
amelia (support): Ticket created: INC-8765 with customer impact notes and workaround.
jay (oncall): Next steps: schedule a controlled rollback of the runtime buffer change in staging and then canary to prod tomorrow morning. Postmortem notes: capture timeline, root cause hypothesis (gateway + runtime interaction on chunked flush semantics), mitigation actions taken, and customer comms.
matt (eng-runtime): I'll open PR to revert the buffer change and add integration test to simulate chunked flush patterns.
amelia (support): I'll send customers the workaround and inform them of timeline for permanent fix.
jay (oncall): Handoff to next oncall @morning-team: I've documented all actions in the incident doc: https://incident.redwood/1764567890. Leaving monitoring alerts at low threshold; escalate if >3% 5xx.
leo (ops): Adding follow-up tasks: verify gateway keepalive/read_timeout matrix across versions, add synthetic streaming checks to e2e, and add extra tracing on chunked frames.
(35m) jay (oncall): closing live triage. Will re-open if we see regression. :white_check_mark:
